title: Machine mode switch offers only Milling, Turning and Mill-turning: no Plasma (or EDM) mode, so the plasma machine and its operation section cannot be reached from the ribbon

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
Reported by the maintainer in chat (2026-11-12), filed by an agent for him: "we have added support for plasma/laser historically, but there is no Machine type for it (milling, lathe, mill-turning) and no section for operations."

**What exists on main (plasma, from #621 and its sub-issues #669-#672):**
- machine kind `Kind::Plasma` (declared in the machine file, never inferred) and the shipped machine `assets/machines/tormach-1300pl.mch`;
- the post "Tormach PathPilot Plasma" (`assets/posts/tormach-plasma.cps`), offered to plasma tables only;
- the operation `Plasma Profile` with its own page, in its own ribbon section `Section::Plasma` (family `Family::Plasma`), a `Torch` tool kind, and the plasma verification laws.

**Why he cannot see any of it.** The ribbon's machine MODE switch is `MACHINE_MODES` in `crates/ui/src/actions.rs`: exactly three entries - `Milling` (mounts "VMC 3-axis"), `Turning` ("Lathe"), `Mill-turning` ("Mill-turn"). There is no Plasma mode, and none for the two EDM kinds that merged today (#551: `wire_edm`, `sinker_edm`). The ribbon shows and enables operation sections by what the mounted machine admits (`KindInfo::admits`), so with a mill, lathe or mill-turn mounted the Plasma section is never offered. The only way in today is the Setup pane's machine picker (`machines_pane.rs`, whose kind list does include Plasma) and choosing the Tormach 1300PL there - nothing on the ribbon says that.

**Laser:** there is no laser support in the code at all - no machine kind, no operation, no post (the word appears only in two comments). If laser cutting is wanted it is new work and gets its own issue; this issue does not add it.

**Wanted**
- The machine mode switch lists every machine kind the app can mount a built-in machine for: add `Plasma cutting` (mounts the Tormach 1300PL, the only shipped plasma table). Switching to it is the same undoable `LoadBuiltinMachine` the other modes use, and the Plasma section with `Plasma Profile` then shows like Turning does under a lathe.
- For the EDM kinds: there is no shipped EDM machine file yet (the fixtures under `crates/app/tests/edm/` are test data), so no mode can mount one today. Do NOT add a mode that mounts nothing; make the mode list data-driven from "kinds that have a built-in reference machine", so an EDM mode appears by itself when a wire or sinker machine file ships (#535 / #548 own the EDM pages). Say so in the PR.
- Where a section is hidden because the mounted machine does not admit it, the user must be able to find out it exists: decide the simplest honest form (e.g. the mode menu's row for Plasma says "Plasma cutting - Plasma Profile"; or the ribbon shows the other kinds' sections greyed with the reason "needs a plasma table"), and record the choice.

Done means: with a new document, the mode switch offers Plasma cutting; choosing it mounts the Tormach 1300PL as one undoable step, the ribbon shows the Plasma section and `Plasma Profile` can be created; switching back to Milling restores the mill sections; the mode list is derived from the built-in machines, pinned by a structural test that fails when a machine kind with a built-in machine has no mode; no snapshot PNG touched.
